fato_historico: 1926: Japan's public broadcasting company, Nippon Hōsō Kyōkai (NHK) is established.
energia_do_dia: Today, your intuitive waters flow with the melody of new beginnings. Much like the birth of a grand broadcast that brings voices together, you may feel an urge to share your inner wisdom. It is a good time to tune into the frequency of your dreams and consider how your unique vision can resonate harmoniously with those around you.
frase_do_dia: Your voice carries the magic of the universe when you speak from the heart.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of wisdom.
conselho: Listen closely to your inner broadcast and trust the messages you receive today.
